title: fullcycle.bats asserts hand-written counts of watched PATH symlinks, and lib/cmd/fullcycle bounds its link walks with its own 40 beside 0247's _DEVBIN_LINK_HOPS
body:
tests/unit/fullcycle.bats asserts `watching: 1 PATH symlink` at :326, :353, :393, :420 and :1980 (main at 3cf668a2): each compares the run's count of watched PATH symlinks against a 1 written by hand, where the fixture made the links the count is of. hv's rule (2026-10-27): a test never compares against a count written down by hand; it derives the expected number from the thing it counts. Separately, lib/cmd/fullcycle bounds its link walks with its own literal 40, at :420 (`[ "$n" -gt 40 ]`) and :701 (`[ "$hops" -le 40 ]`), and 0247 (0.1.16) brings `_DEVBIN_LINK_HOPS` into lib/helpers as the one bound for walking a chain of links: once 0247 lands, two bounds say the same thing in two places. Found by the critic-shell review of 0247 and 0249 (2026-10-28); measured on main by vc. Filed by vc; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Fix

1. Each arm derives the expected count from the links its fixture made (eg the length of the array it built them from, or a count of them read from the PATH directories), and asserts the line with that number.
2. lib/cmd/fullcycle's two walks use `_DEVBIN_LINK_HOPS`, and the literal 40 goes.

## Done when

1. No fullcycle.bats arm asserts a hand-written count of watched links.
2. lib/cmd/fullcycle holds no literal bound on link steps; both walks read `_DEVBIN_LINK_HOPS`.
3. fullcycle.bats passes under BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

- No fullcycle.bats arm compares the watch's count with a number written by hand. fixture_links counts the symbolic links in the fixture's PATH directories that lead into the project, and fails when there are none. The six arms that asserted `watching: 1 PATH symlink` assert the watch line with that count: five on the dark-link fixture's pathbin, and 0139's on its own directory.
- lib/cmd/fullcycle holds no literal bound on link steps. _fullcycle_link_in_tree's walk and the name-at-a-time resolver both read _DEVBIN_LINK_HOPS (0247), and so does the comment naming the bound.
- Landed on main at cdd1d3da.
- Arms: the six in tests/unit/fullcycle.bats (0068, 0071, 0072 twice, 0248 and 0139), all ok in run 1314.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run on rhadamanth, sealed at tmp/test/20261029-1314.bats.out and .bats.errors: 2824 ok and 2 not ok, neither of them this issue's.
